Counts are live public video metadata captured on 2 November 2026. These are cumulative video views, not unique viewers, and individual videos were retrieved over a short collection window rather than at the exact same instant. Shorts, final-kilometre clips, previews, compilations, earlier seasons and other races are excluded.

International setup

ASFC starts at kickoff: review audience geography and existing channel settings, enable available features with Giro, and coordinate with YouTube where needed. We agree priority languages and rollout together, adapt packaging using approved language assets, and review performance by market before expanding. There is no fixed video or language quota in this proposal.

ASFC owns setup, planning and coordination. Outside translation, captioning and dubbing services have a separate budget. The cycling language preview is an illustrative adaptation, not a live channel screenshot. Feature access and supported languages are confirmed in YouTube Studio.

References: YouTube multilingual audio and thumbnails and translated titles and descriptions.

Proposed commercial scope

The Plan: $10,000 one time, USD. YouTube and social audit, back-catalog opportunities, creator and international strategy, a roadmap and a creative workshop. Giro implements the standalone plan.

The Partner: $20,000 per month for an initial 90 days, $60,000 total, USD. Strategy and setup are included with no separate Plan fee. Unlimited title, thumbnail and SEO packaging covers Giro’s new releases and existing catalog. There is no monthly video cap, fixed creator-brief allowance or per-video variant/revision cap.

ASFC handles full creative development for titles, thumbnails and SEO. Our proprietary back-catalog software supports discovery, updates and optimization. We develop creator concepts, source collaborators, prepare briefs and plan collaborations throughout the engagement. YouTube and social distribution strategy, international coordination, weekly sessions with Giro’s creative team and monthly reporting support an ongoing improvement system.

Giro supplies access, footage availability and rights guidance, and handles filming, editing, approvals and publication. Production, paid creator fees, travel and outside language services are separately budgeted. Concepts do not imply secured creator participation or sponsorship.
